title: Comment
description: A comment on a Lemmy post, supporting threaded nested replies via path-based hierarchy.

creator_id.description: ID of the user who wrote the comment

post_id.description: ID of the post this comment belongs to

removed.description: Whether the comment was removed by a moderator

published.description: Timestamp when the comment was published

updated.description: Timestamp when the comment was last updated

deleted.description: Whether the comment was deleted by the author

local.description: Whether the comment originated on this instance

path.description: Dot-delimited path of comment IDs representing the nesting hierarchy (e.g., '0.1.5.7')

distinguished.description: Whether the comment is highlighted/distinguished by a moderator

language_id.description: ID of the language the comment is written in
